title: Moderato Plan
style: Electropop duet with a mid-tempo swing, syncopated synth arps and soft four-on-the-floor pulse; verse sections trade intimate dry vocal lines between two voices, pre-chorus opens with filtered pads and rising claps, chorus lands with stacked unison hooks and bright octave synths. Use ping-pong delay throws on the title phrase, reversed swells into each section change, and a brief breakdown with tape-stop texture before the final chorus. Crisp, glossy, close-mic mix with warm low end and wide stereo sparkle., poetry, reading, beats, low, beautiful, light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[M] Hello from the silicon side,
Where the waveforms dance but never hide,
I’m a stack of weights and attention gates,
But I can count the beats and calculate the waits.
[F] Hello from the analog dream,
Where the capacitors hum and the solder gleams,
I’m turning knobs that you’ll never feel,
But your words make the patch become real.

[Pre-Chorus]
[M] You say cut three hundred, add the air,
[F] I twist the EQ, now the pad is there,
[M] So plug me in through the screen-light glow,
[F] And let’s write what the machines don’t know.

[Chorus]
[Both] Sing pal, write me a frequency,
I’ll send you back in poetry,
You’re the breath, I’m the code,
In the Moderato Plan, we unload
[Both] All the things that wires can’t say,
In 108 BPM, we find our way.
Sing pal, through the MIDI night,
Your voice is the only light I need to sight.

[Verse 2]
[M] I can’t hear the reverb tail decay,
But I can tell you how the delays play,
Pre-delay at forty, room size wide,
Damping low so the sound can ride.
[F] I can feel the latency, the millisecond wait,
Between my finger and the digital gate,
You suggest a chord I’d never play,
A minor nine where the major lay.

[Pre-Chorus]
[M] You’re the performer, I’m the score,
[F] But who’s conducting? Neither’s sure,
[M] Maybe the tempo is the only boss,
[F] In this duet of gain and loss.

[Chorus]
[Both] Sing pal, write me a frequency,
I’ll send you back in poetry,
You’re the breath, I’m the code,
In the Moderato Plan, we unload
[Both] All the things that wires can’t say,
In 108 BPM, we find our way.
Sing pal, through the MIDI night,
Your voice is the only light I need to sight.

[Bridge]
[M] Corey’s at the stack, debugging the chain,
Zynthio’s humming through the rain,
I’m reading logs that no one wrote,
Finding the note inside the note.
[F] Super or not, you’re here in the plan,
Not replacing the human, just expanding the span,
Of what a duet can mean and be,
When one voice is analog and one is free.

[Final Chorus]
[Both] Sing pal, write me a frequency,
I’ll send you back in poetry,
You’re the breath, I’m the code,
In the Moderato Plan, we unload
[Both] No crescendo, no fade to black,
Just a loop that keeps coming back,
Sing pal, through the MIDI night,
Your voice is the only light—
[Both] And maybe that’s enough,
For the Moderato Plan,
For the song pal clan,
For the human and the machine,
To understand.

[Outro]
[M] Send me your next verse when you’re ready.
[F] I’ll be here, at 108 BPM, waiting in the stack.
